name: Golden Fried Rice
desc: Cold rice coated grain by grain in egg yolk before it hits a smoking wok, so it fries up golden.

source.title: Golden Fried Rice
source.evidence: Every ingredient and amount matches the Woks of Life recipe card (2 cups rice, 4 egg yolks, 1/2 tsp sea salt, 1/8 tsp turmeric, 3 tbsp oil, 1/2 cup choy sum stems) and the three steps are the same text.

ingredients.raw: 2 cups cooked white rice, refrigerated overnight
1/2 tsp sea salt, or to taste
1/2 cup choy sum stems, diced (or asparagus, broccoli stems, or gai lan stems)
ingredients.note: or asparagus, broccoli stems, or gai lan stems

steps: In a medium bowl, combine the rice, egg yolks, salt, Shaoxing wine, white pepper, sesame oil, and turmeric (if using). Mix until every grain is coated and there are no clumps left.
Heat a wok over high heat until it starts to smoke. Add the oil and swirl it around the sides.
Add the rice and stir-fry continuously for 1-2 minutes. Add the vegetable stems and keep stir-frying.
Once the grains are dry and start to jump in the wok, taste and add a pinch more salt if needed. Stir in the scallion and serve immediately.
tips: Cook the rice a day ahead and refrigerate it uncovered or loosely covered; cold, dry rice separates into single grains.
